findingDetails.title: The hub front-door instruction splices the user task into a double-quoted shell argument
findingDetails.description: SKILL.md:62 and ROUTER.md:105 tell the agent to pass the task through --prompt in double quotes; a task quoting UI text truncates at the first inner quote and a task with a command substitution executes it. compiled-route.cjs:43 documents --prompt-stdin for user prompts and neither hub doc mentions it.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both docs are hub-owned and inside the declared review target; the CLI they name is the front door the hub completion criterion exercises.

findingDetails.title: The Aside feature catalog still offers the unpinned curl-to-bash install
findingDetails.description: The install entry presents curl -fsSL releases.aside.com/install.sh piped to bash as an equal first option beside the digest-pinned wrapper, contradicting phase 015 decision D2.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The feature catalog entry and the wrapper are both inside the Aside packet, inside the declared review target.

findingDetails.title: The installer pin covers the script but not the archive, and the archive source is env-overridable
findingDetails.description: INSTALLER_SHA256 verifies the downloaded script only; the comment says the archive is unverified, and ASIDE_CLI_BASE_URL is passed through, so the unverified archive source is environment-controlled.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The wrapper and its documented env overrides are both inside the Aside packet.

results.summary: Decision D2 implemented in the wrapper but contradicted by the feature catalog
Installer test suite covers the wrapper, not the catalog line that bypasses it
3d-canon PASS: every mode carries toolSurface with mutatesWorkspace true
No agent definition carries hub logic
Aside install catalog documents a path the packet decision record forbids

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new: the front-door shell interpolation, the unpinned catalog install path and the archive-source gap. Weighted new = 5 + 5 + 1 = 11 against weighted total 11, so the ratio is 1.0.
ruledOut: Shell injection through the capture example URL: quote and backslash rejected before splicing
Path traversal through the capture example session dir: the .. case runs before the prefix case
Understated mutation posture in the compiled policy: mutatesWorkspace true maps to workspace-mutation-capable
A second unpinned install path inside the wrapper: it downloads to mktemp and never pipes to a shell
